# sngl test drives the testagent over JSON-RPC and reports PASS.


sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component counter node {
    var count = 0
    button(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
    text(value=string(count))
}

func testStartsAtZero(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.count == 0)
}

func testIncrementWorks(t Test, c counter) {
    c.count = 5
    t.assert(c.count == 5)
}

window {
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/counter/1 --
sha256:ae61f2e8f333f261e322ca999097cafc
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "IncrementWorks",
      "Passed": true
    },
    {
      "Desc": "StartsAtZero",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
